title: Consolidation, Promotion & Explicit Limitations
rationale: Rather than engineering additional handcrafted artifact branches which Phase D proved yield no orthogonal ranking information and produce elevated false alarm rates (28-47%), the system formally consolidates the multi-domain representation as the research champion, promotes it to the production inference and API service layers, and couples it with strict operational limitations disclosures.

explicit_limitations.details: Subtle expression manipulations (Face2Face) operate inside the natural human facial subspace without boundary seams, yielding ~38-43% sensitivity compared to 89-100% on Deepfakes and NeuralTextures.

Standalone frequency and texture branches produce elevated false alarms (28-47% on clean reals); their noisy anomaly signals are gated/suppressed by the multi-domain fusion head rather than providing orthogonal independent certainty.

Standard threshold (tau=0.50) achieves 93.88% clean specificity; high-sensitivity operating point in calibrated space (tau*=0.1260, corresponding to tau=0.0190 in raw sigmoid space) increases Face2Face recall to 43.10% while accepting a 6.12% false alarm rate (6 false alarms on 98 clean reals).
Cross-domain transfer to Celeb-DF v2 yields ~0.796 AUC, exhibiting expected domain-shift degradation relative to seen synthesis families (>0.98 AUC).
Model scores represent statistical confidence within the validated distribution, not objective physical proof or sole legal evidence. Avoid treating high decision margins as epistemic certainty.
Penultimate feature distance is an experimental diagnostic indicator (threshold 3.18, 99th percentile across 343 validation clean reals), not a validated 3-state autonomous rejection filter.
